kinds.summary: A depletion run's time steps, power or flux normalisation, k at each step, per-material nuclide densities and provenance, on a heavy-metal basis.
kinds.manual: In OpenMC Studio, run a depletion (the Reactor Physics package; it needs the depletion chain file) and save its depletion record, a studio.depletion JSON written next to the statepoint. Give that file to the app that asks for it.
